candidates.problem: The two inclusion directions are reversed. Since every kernel under consideration contains $N$, the immediate inclusion is $N\subset\bigcap \Ker\chi_{i}$, not $N\supset\bigcap \Ker\chi_{i}$. The regular-representation argument that follows proves the opposite inclusion, namely $N\supset\bigcap \Ker\chi_{i}$.
candidates.proposed_fix: Swap the symbols: it should read “$\subset$ は明らか。$\supset$：” so that the obvious inclusion is $N\subset\bigcap \Ker\chi_{i}$, and the subsequent argument proves $N\supset\bigcap \Ker\chi_{i}$.
